# Drama Club
[color=#999999][italic]...is a meetup of many actors to put a good show[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=#ff0000]Traitors[/color]
Key Identities: [color=royalblue]Tragedian[/color]
## Summary
With a high quantity of Tragedians, you can expect a lot of people acting odd and playing out a theme only they know.
This chaos drives action by itself, both from those acting their heart out and the Traitors disguising their actions behind a mask of their own.
Expect the unexpected! A lot of people will want to die for their objectives, so try to fill into any jobs that might need it.
